description: Election Commission - A. C. M. Latiff wes elected as the member of the Batticaloa Municipal Council
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy for a member of the Batticaloa Municipal Council, which is a process directly related to electoral matters under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the procedure for declaring a new elected member due to a vacancy caused by non-attendance of meetings, which falls under the category of electoral processes and declarations.
